factor_name: Low-volatility downside-risk quality with trend conditioning

calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when total and downside volatility are low, with a smooth positive/negative 120-day trend modifier. The signal is shifted one day so only completed data are used at decision time.
calculation.implementation_notes: Cross-sectional Spearman IC across the 15 tradable benchmark instruments; minimum 8 valid instruments per date. DXY, VIX and other observation-only series are not tradable and are not dependencies.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-day cross-sectional IC with modest hit ratio; low average valid cross-section and low coverage make uncertainty material. Results are most appropriate as a defensive quality sleeve rather than a standalone portfolio signal.
